values: 选择最靠前的一名友军作为“友人”，主动释放时为“友人”提供大量增益。
Isabella selects the frontmost ally as her companion. When she casts her Ultimate, she grants the companion powerful buffs.

战斗开始时选择最靠前的一名友方英雄作为“友人”，“友人”被击败后会重新选择。当“友人”每受到一次攻击力、攻击速度、急速、护甲、魔抗或受愈属性提升效果时，伊莎贝拉将在书中永久记录一层该属性对应的“咒文”，每种属性的咒文最多记录3层，“咒文”带来的属性提升不会被重复记录。
主动释放时，使“友人”提升15% + 1.5%攻击力和15 + 1.5点急速，持续6秒，且每层被记录的“咒文”都会额外提升对应的属性（攻击力、护甲、魔抗：每层咒文提高15%的属性。攻击速度、急速、受愈：每层咒文提高15属性）。

When a battle starts, Isabella selects the frontmost allied hero as her companion. If the companion is defeated, Isabella will select a new one. Whenever the companion receives a stat boost to ATK, ATK SPD, Haste, Phys DEF, Magic DEF, or Vitality, Isabella gains a permanent stack of spell note corresponding to that stat. Each type of spell note can stack up to 3 times. Note that stat boosts granted by Isabella's spell notes themselves do not trigger additional stacks of spell notes.
When Isabella casts her Ultimate, she increases her companion's ATK by 15% + 1.5% and their Haste by 15 + 1.5 for 6s. Additionally, each spell note stack Isabella carries will increase the companion's corresponding stat:
ATK, Phys DEF, and Magic DEF: +15% per stack.
ATK SPD, Haste, and Vitality: +15 per stack.
主动释放时，“友人”获得增益的持续时间提升至6.5秒。
When Isabella uses her Ultimate, the buffs she grants to her companion last 6.5s.
主动释放时，“友人”获得增益的持续时间提升至7秒。
When Isabella uses her Ultimate, the buffs she grants to her companion last 7s.
主动释放时，“友人”获得增益的持续时间提升至7.5秒。
When Isabella uses her Ultimate, the buffs she grants to her companion last 7.5s.
主动释放时，“友人”获得增益的持续时间提升至8秒。
When Isabella uses her Ultimate, the buffs she grants to her companion last 8s.
治疗“友人”，并对其附近敌人造成伤害。
Isabella heals her companion and deals damage to enemies around them.
本技能只会选择“友人”为目标。为其恢复-340% − 40% ATK生命值，随后对“友人”1格范围内的敌人造成150% ATK伤害，并为“友人”恢复等同于实际伤害量100%的生命值。

Isabella targets only her companion with this skill, healing them for -340% − 40% ATK HP and then dealing 150% ATK damage to enemies adjacent to her companion. 100% of the damage dealt is also converted into extra healing for her companion.
生命值恢复量提升至-360% − 40% ATK。
Increases the amount of direct healing to -360% − 40% ATK.
生命值恢复量提升至-380% − 40% ATK。
Increases the amount of direct healing to -380% − 40% ATK.
生命值恢复量提升至-400% − 40% ATK。
Increases the amount of direct healing to -400% − 40% ATK.
当“友人”被控制时使其获得霸体，当“友人”受到伤害时降低敌方攻击力。
After her companion is affected by control effects, Isabella can make them unaffected. Additionally, when her companion takes damage, Isabella can reduce the attacker's ATK.
当“友人”被累计控制5秒后，使其获得2.5 + 0.25秒的霸体，5秒内至多生效一次。当敌方英雄对“友人”累计造成350% ATK伤害时，使该敌人攻击力下降60% + 7% ATK，持续5秒，5秒内至多生效一次。

After her companion is affected by control effects for 5s, Isabella can make them unaffected for 2.5 + 0.25s. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.
Additionally, when an enemy hero deals 350% ATK damage to her companion, Isabella reduces that enemy's ATK by 60% + 7% ATK for 5s. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.
敌方攻击力下降的幅度提升至65% + 7% ATK。
Increases the ATK reduction inflicted by Isabella to 65% + 7% ATK.
敌方攻击力下降的幅度提升至70% + 7% ATK。
Increases the ATK reduction inflicted by Isabella to 70% + 7% ATK.
敌方攻击力下降的幅度提升至75% + 7% ATK。
Increases the ATK reduction inflicted by Isabella to 75% + 7% ATK.
战斗中，自身的支援提升30点。
战斗中，自身的支援提升40点。
战斗中，自身的支援提升50点。
释放终极技能时，额外对一名敌方英雄造成减益效果。
When casting her Ultimate, Isabella also debuffs an enemy hero.
释放终极技能时，额外选择本次战斗中对“友人”累计输出最高的一名敌方英雄，根据此次终极技能的“咒文”，对其造成同种属性的减益效果，强度为增益效果的80%，持续8秒。

When Isabella casts her Ultimate, she also debuffs the enemy hero who has dealt the most damage to her companion, temporarily reducing the stats linked to active spell note stacks from Isabella's Ultimate. The debuffs last 8s and are 80% as effective as the corresponding buffs from spell note stacks.
减益效果的强度增加至90%。
Increases debuff effectiveness to 90% of the original buff value.
终极技能效果结束时，每有一个属性对应的“咒文”达到最高层数，使自身恢复180点能量。每次释放终极技能时，伊莎贝拉至多通过该效果恢复540点能量。
When a buff from Isabella's Ultimate expires, she recovers 180 Energy for every spell note type at maximum stacks. Each time Isabella casts her Ultimate, she can recover up to 540 Energy this way.
减益效果的强度增加至100%。
Increases debuff effectiveness to 100% of the original buff value.
当“友人”获得大量增益时，额外叠加一层“咒文”。
Whenever Isabella's companion receives a powerful buff, Isabella gains an extra stack of spell note.
若“友人”受到的增益效果，提升攻击力、护甲、魔抗的数值不低于15%，或提升攻速、急速、受愈的数值不低于15点，则额外记录一层该属性对应的“咒文”。

Whenever Isabella's companion receives a buff that increases their ATK, Phys DEF, or Magic DEF by at least 15%, or increases their ATK SPD, Haste, or Vitality by at least 15, Isabella gains an extra stack of the corresponding spell note.
每次记录“咒文”时额外获得60点能量，至多通过该途径获得600点能量，且每层咒文提供的属性增幅提高25%。若和西尔维娜一同上阵，额外将西尔维娜视为“友人”。

Whenever Isabella records a spell note, she gains an extra 60 Energy, up to a total of 600 Energy gained this way. In addition, the stat boost provided by each spell note stack increases by 25%.
If an allied Silvina is deployed, Isabella treats her as an additional companion.
